doctrine: Catalogue versionne des evenements FREKCORE (Bloc 7). Chaque entree distingue le contrat specifie de son etat d'implementation reel — Evidence First (voir reports/02_GAP_ANALYSIS.md).

envelope_schema.title: FREK Event Envelope
envelope_schema.description: Enveloppe generique pour tout evenement FREKCORE v1. Implementee par backend/eventbus/envelope.py:EventEnvelope (Phase 2, Priorite 5) et emise par de vrais producteurs a partir de Phase 2 Priorite 6 (voir 'implemented' par entree du catalogue ci-dessous).

producer.description: Module qui a emis l'evenement, ex: 'identity_engine'.

subject.description: FREK-ID principal concerne par l'evenement, si applicable.

correlation_id.description: Identifiant reliant plusieurs evenements d'une meme requete/flux.

causation_id.description: event_id de l'evenement qui a directement cause celui-ci, si applicable.

schema_version.description: Version du schema du payload (pas de l'enveloppe).

catalog.evidence: Phase 2 Priorite 6: backend/identity_engine/routes.py:126-130 (POST /identity/init) publishes a real EventEnvelope via backend/eventbus/bus.py:default_bus, built by backend/eventbus/producers.py:build_identity_created_event(). Publish is best-effort (wrapped in try/except, never blocks identity creation — see routes.py:39-43,124-130). Verified by backend/tests/test_eventbus.py::test_build_identity_created_event_matches_envelope_contract and test_identity_engine_wires_eventbus_without_raising_on_publish_failure (unit, no live server/Mongo needed). NOT yet verified end-to-end against a live server + MongoDB in this sandbox (see reports/10_TEST_INFRASTRUCTURE.md) — the wiring itself is real code, not aspirational, but full integration coverage remains a gap.

P1 backlog (2026-08-31): backend/identity_engine/routes.py's PATCH /{frek_id} (update_identity) publishes a real EventEnvelope via backend/eventbus/producers.py:build_identity_updated_event(), best-effort (try/except, never blocks the response). payload carries changed_fields (names only, never the new values, so this event can't leak PII by existing) — see docs/architecture/FREK_ID_RECONCILIATION.md's P1 implementation update. Verified by backend/tests/test_eventbus.py::test_build_identity_updated_event_never_carries_field_values (unit) and backend/tests/test_identity_lifecycle.py::TestUpdate (live, mongomock-backed server).

catalog.description: Fusion de deux identites (Bloc 2 — Identity Engine: Merge).
catalog.evidence: Aucune route ou fonction de merge trouvee sous backend/identity_engine/ (grep: pas de 'merge').

P1 backlog (2026-08-31): backend/identity_engine/routes.py's POST /{frek_id}/revocation (revoke_identity — see docs/architecture/FREK_ID_RECONCILIATION.md for why the path is /revocation, not /revoke: frek_v1 already owns POST /{frek_id}/revoke at the identical mounted path) publishes a real EventEnvelope via backend/eventbus/producers.py:build_identity_revoked_event(), best-effort. Also notarized (payload_type=identity_revocation, backend/notary/service.py:notarize_event()). Distinct from frek_identities.revoked (frek_v1's own, separate field/system — see reports/FREKCORE_CONTRADICTIONS.md C1) — this entry now covers identity_engine's revoke. Verified by backend/tests/test_eventbus.py::test_build_identity_revoked_event_matches_envelope_contract and backend/tests/test_identity_lifecycle.py::TestRevoke (live, mongomock-backed server).

catalog.description: Creation d'un objet culturel (FK Cultural Object Container).
catalog.evidence: backend/fk/routes.py POST /fk/create persiste l'objet et son attestation mais ne publie aucun evenement versionne consommable par un tiers.
backend/fk/routes.py POST /fk/verify retourne un resultat synchrone au caller mais n'emet pas d'evenement persistant/diffuse.

catalog.description: Nouvelle preuve emise par le Proof Engine (notary block / passport).
catalog.evidence: backend/notary/service.py:notarize_event() cree un bloc signe et l'ecrit dans notary_blocks (voir backend/notary/routes.py POST /notary/notarize). C'est un log append-only interne, pas un evenement publie/versionne au sens Event Bus (pas de souscription possible).
